thread:
evan: opened a small docs PR to tighten Dedicated provisioning wording and add micro-examples: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2060
evan: TL;DR: clarify eviction impact on in-flight requests, add a short cooldown recommendation, and include tiny terraform + python examples.
nora: quick nit: make it explicit that bursts still honor tenant isolation. otherwise LGTM.
sam: adding examples here  terraform:
```hcl
resource "redwood_dedicated_scale_policy" "ex" {
  tenant_id        = "tenant-blue"
  min_gpus         = 1
  max_gpus         = 4
  cooldown_seconds = 240
  preemption_policy = "notify-and-drain"
}
```
sam: python one-liner:
```python
from redwood import DedicatedClient
DedicatedClient().set_scale_policy("tenant-blue", min_gpus=1, max_gpus=4, cooldown_seconds=240, preemption_policy="notify-and-drain")
```
mira: tiny migration note: rename `scaleCooldownMs` -> `cooldown_seconds` and convert ms->s (jq suggestion in PR).
docs-bot: doc build passed for branch docs/pr-2060 (links: 0 warn).
